clinical_notes.content: Patient Aisha Williams, 34 y/o female with recurrent Major Depressive Disorder, moderate (F33.1), has completed 20 sessions of individual CBT in the current calendar year (2024-01-09 through 2024-08-27). Patient has demonstrated consistent, measurable improvement: PHQ-9 decreased from 18 (moderately severe) at baseline to 12 (moderate) at most recent assessment. Despite this meaningful progress, the patient has not yet achieved the treatment target of PHQ-9 < 10 (mild range) and continues to meet diagnostic criteria for moderate MDD. The patient has made significant functional gains, including returning to part-time employment in June 2024, but has not yet achieved the goal of full-time employment. CBT technique application remains inconsistent under stress, indicating the need for continued consolidation work. Abrupt discontinuation of therapy at this stage would carry significant risk of symptom regression, particularly given the patient's recurrent episode pattern (F33.1). Requesting authorization for session 21 (CPT 90837) to continue evidence-based treatment. Medical necessity justification package to be submitted with PHQ-9 scores, treatment plan, and progress documentation.
